Menopause has become one of the most profitable words in wellness.

The Guardian reported this month on a review of more than 200 menopause supplements that found limited evidence they work. UCL's Professor Joyce Harper has warned that women risk being exploited.

The things with real backing are less exciting to sell: a GP conversation about HRT, strength work, vitamin D and knowing your triggers. Most of them cost nothing.

What's the most expensive thing you've bought for perimenopause or menopause?

Save this for your next GP appointment, and send it to a friend going through it.
